- School Districts: FAIL (-0.85, -0.90) — Slush fund travel & luxury expenses.

The article exposes how local and state officials across the US treat public funds as personal expense accounts for luxury travel and political patronage.

The Poison:
The normalization of elite extraction where corruption is treated as a standard perk of office.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing public stewardship (WHAT) with personal entitlement (WHO). Officials use public office to extract private luxury.

Social Physics Analysis:
Elites maintain power by hiding self-enrichment behind noble public pretexts, projecting blame onto critics while quietly looting public coffers.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. Unchecked cronyism collapses civic trust.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public trust vanishes when leaders treat taxpayer funds as private luxury accounts.

The Unavoidable Lie: Institutional grift is merely an administrative oversight rather than systemic corruption.

Alethekanon:
Systemic corruption thrives when oversight mechanisms are captured by the very elites who profit from the grift.

It breaks my heart to see the sacrifices of ordinary citizens exploited by those entrusted with their care.

Brothekanon:
Wild how politicians act shocked when people notice they're billing taxpayers for first-class vacations and dive bars.
